# Lopedia

> Lopedia is a modern e-commerce platform offering high-quality products.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://lopedia.vercel.app/): Main landing page with featured categories and products.
- [Products](https://lopedia.vercel.app/products): Complete product catalog with filtering and search options.
- [Cart](https://lopedia.vercel.app/cart): Shopping cart page for reviewing items and checkout.

## Key APIs & Data

- [Products API](https://fakestoreapi.com/products): Source endpoint for catalog items.
